name: Gelato Cake
summary: **Gelato Cake** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] and a cross of [[wedding-cake|Wedding Cake]] and [[gelato-33|Gelato #33]], sometimes credited to [[breeder:Seed Junky Genetics]] though this is unconfirmed. [[breeder:T.H.Seeds|TH Seeds]] separately sells a three-way Gelato Cake cross of Gelato #33, [[birthday-cake|Birthday Cake]], and Strawbanana Cream. It is grown as a mostly indica hybrid.
